cases.name: ranking
cases.sql: SELECT x, row_number() OVER (ORDER BY x), rank() OVER (ORDER BY x), dense_rank() OVER (ORDER BY x), percent_rank() OVER (ORDER BY x), cume_dist() OVER (ORDER BY x) FROM (VALUES 1, 2, 2, 3) t(x) ORDER BY x

cases.name: ntile_fn
cases.sql: SELECT x, ntile(3) OVER (ORDER BY x) FROM (VALUES 1, 2, 3, 4, 5) t(x) ORDER BY x

cases.name: lag_lead
cases.sql: SELECT x, lag(x) OVER (ORDER BY x), lead(x, 2) OVER (ORDER BY x), lag(x, 1, -1) OVER (ORDER BY x) FROM (VALUES 1, 2, 3) t(x) ORDER BY x

cases.name: first_last_nth
cases.sql: SELECT x, first_value(x) OVER (ORDER BY x), last_value(x) OVER (ORDER BY x), nth_value(x, 2) OVER (ORDER BY x ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND UNBOUNDED FOLLOWING) FROM (VALUES 1, 2, 3) t(x) ORDER BY x

cases.name: window_nulls
cases.sql: SELECT x, rank() OVER (ORDER BY x NULLS FIRST), lag(x) OVER (ORDER BY x NULLS FIRST) FROM (VALUES 1, CAST(NULL AS integer), 2) t(x) ORDER BY x NULLS FIRST

cases.name: window_partition_frame
cases.sql: SELECT g, x, sum(x) OVER (PARTITION BY g ORDER BY x ROWS BETWEEN 1 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW), avg(x) OVER (PARTITION BY g), count(*) OVER (PARTITION BY g ORDER BY x RANGE BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) FROM (VALUES (1, 1), (1, 2), (1, 2), (2, 5)) t(g, x) ORDER BY g, x

cases.name: window_empty
cases.sql: SELECT x, row_number() OVER () FROM (VALUES 1) t(x) WHERE false

cases.name: ranking_ties_desc
cases.sql: SELECT x, rank() OVER (ORDER BY x DESC), dense_rank() OVER (ORDER BY x DESC), percent_rank() OVER (ORDER BY x DESC), cume_dist() OVER (ORDER BY x DESC) FROM (VALUES 5, 5, 3) t(x) ORDER BY x DESC

cases.name: ranking_partitions
cases.sql: SELECT g, x, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY g ORDER BY x), dense_rank() OVER (PARTITION BY g ORDER BY x), ntile(2) OVER (PARTITION BY g ORDER BY x) FROM (VALUES (1, 10), (1, 20), (1, 30), (2, 5)) t(g, x) ORDER BY g, x

cases.name: single_row_windows
cases.sql: SELECT percent_rank() OVER (ORDER BY x), cume_dist() OVER (ORDER BY x), ntile(3) OVER (ORDER BY x), rank() OVER (ORDER BY x) FROM (VALUES 1) t(x)

cases.name: lead_lag_defaults
cases.sql: SELECT x, lead(x) OVER (ORDER BY x), lead(x, 1, 0) OVER (ORDER BY x), lag(x, 2) OVER (ORDER BY x) FROM (VALUES 1, 2, 3) t(x) ORDER BY x

cases.name: value_functions_frames
cases.sql: SELECT x, first_value(x) OVER (ORDER BY x ROWS BETWEEN 1 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING), last_value(x) OVER (ORDER BY x ROWS BETWEEN 1 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING), nth_value(x, 3) OVER (ORDER BY x) FROM (VALUES 1, 2, 3, 4) t(x) ORDER BY x

cases.name: value_functions_nulls
cases.sql: SELECT x, first_value(x) OVER (ORDER BY x NULLS FIRST), last_value(x) OVER (ORDER BY x NULLS FIRST ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND UNBOUNDED FOLLOWING), nth_value(x, 1) OVER (ORDER BY x NULLS FIRST) FROM (VALUES CAST(NULL AS integer), 2) t(x) ORDER BY x NULLS FIRST

cases.name: lead_offsets
cases.sql: SELECT x, lead(x, 0) OVER (ORDER BY x), lead(x, 5, -1) OVER (ORDER BY x) FROM (VALUES 1, 2) t(x) ORDER BY x
